versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἔχοντα ἐξουσίαν μεγάλην, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐφωτίσθη ἐκ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
controles.kjv: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
controles.livre: E depois destas coisas eu vi outro anjo descendo do céu, tendo grande poder; e a terra foi iluminada pela sua glória.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔκραξεν ἐν ἰσχυρᾷ φωνῇ λέγων Ἔπεσεν ἔπεσεν Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη, καὶ ἐγένετο κατοικητήριον δαιμονίων καὶ φυλακὴ παντὸς πνεύματος ἀκαθάρτου καὶ φυλακὴ παντὸς ὀρνέου ἀκαθάρτου καὶ μεμισημένου,

controles.web: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!
controles.kjv: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
controles.livre: E ele clamou fortemente em alta voz, dizendo: Caiu! Caiu a grande Babilônia, e ela se tornou habitação de demônios, e prisão de todo espírito imundo, e prisão de toda ave impura e odiável;

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς πέπωκαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς μετ’ αὐτῆς ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ στρήνους αὐτῆς ἐπλούτησαν.

controles.web: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
controles.kjv: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
controles.livre: Porque todas as nações têm bebido do vinho da ira da prostituição dela, e os reis da terra se prostituíram com ela, e os comerciantes da terra se enriqueceram com o poder da sensualidade dela.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤκουσα ἄλλην φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λέγουσαν Ἐξέλθατε ὁ λαός μου ἐξ αὐτῆς, ἵνα μὴ συνκοινωνήσητε ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν πληγῶν αὐτῆς ἵνα μὴ λάβητε·

controles.web: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
controles.kjv: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
controles.livre: E eu ouvi outra voz do céu, dizendo: Saí dela, povo meu! Para que não sejais participantes dos pecados dela, e para que não recebais das pragas dela.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐκολλήθησαν αὐτῆς αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἄχρι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἐμνημόνευσεν ὁ Θεὸς τὰ ἀδικήματα αὐτῆς.

controles.web: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
controles.kjv: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
controles.livre: Porque os pecados dela se acumularam até o céu, e Deus se lembrou das maldades dela.

versos.grego: ἀπόδοτε αὐτῇ ὡς καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπέδωκεν, καὶ διπλώσατε τὰ διπλᾶ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῆς· ἐν τῷ ποτηρίῳ ᾧ ἐκέρασεν κεράσατε αὐτῇ διπλοῦν·

controles.web: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
controles.kjv: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
controles.livre: Retribuí a ela assim como ela tem vos retribuído, e duplicai a ela em dobro, conforme as obras dela; no cálice em que ela preparou, preparai em dobro para ela.

versos.grego: ὅσα ἐδόξασεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐστρηνίασεν, τοσοῦτον δότε αὐτῇ βασανισμὸν καὶ πένθος. ὅτι ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς λέγει ὅτι Κάθημαι βασίλισσα καὶ χήρα οὐκ εἰμί, καὶ πένθος οὐ μὴ ἴδω·

controles.web: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
controles.kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
controles.livre: O quanto ela glorificou a si mesma, e viveu sensualmente, tanto quanto dai a ela de tormento e pranto; porque ela em seu coração diz: Eu estou sentada como rainha e não sou viúva, e nenhum pranto eu verei.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ ἥξουσιν αἱ πληγαὶ αὐτῆς, θάνατος καὶ πένθος καὶ λιμός, καὶ ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται· ὅτι ἰσχυρὸς Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ κρίνας αὐτήν.

controles.web: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
controles.livre: Portanto em um dia virão as pragas sobre ela: morte, pranto e fome; e ela será queimada com fogo; porque forte é o Senhor Deus, que a julga.

versos.grego: καὶ κλαύσουσιν καὶ κόψονται ἐπ’ αὐτὴν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς οἱ μετ’ αὐτῆς πορνεύσαντες καὶ στρηνιάσαντες, ὅταν βλέπωσιν τὸν καπνὸν τῆς πυρώσεως αὐτῆς,

controles.web: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
controles.kjv: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
controles.livre: E os reis da terra, que se prostituíram com ela, e viveram sensualmente, prantearão por ela, quando virem a fumaça de sua queima.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἑστηκότες διὰ τὸν φόβον τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῆς, λέγοντες Οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, Βαβυλὼν ἡ πόλις ἡ ἰσχυρά, ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἦλθεν ἡ κρίσις σου.

controles.web: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
controles.kjv: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
controles.livre: Estando de longe, por medo do tormento dela, dizendo: Ai, ai daquela grande cidade de Babilônia, aquela forte cidade! Porque em uma hora veio o teu julgamento.

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς γῆς κλαίουσιν καὶ πενθοῦσιν ἐπ’ αὐτήν, ὅτι τὸν γόμον αὐτῶν οὐδεὶς ἀγοράζει οὐκέτι,

controles.web: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;
controles.kjv: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
controles.livre: E os comerciantes da terra choram e lamentam sobre ela, porque ninguém mais compra as mercadorias deles:

versos.grego: γόμον χρυσοῦ καὶ ἀργύρου καὶ λίθου τιμίου καὶ μαργαριτῶν καὶ βυσσίνου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ σιρικοῦ καὶ κοκκίνου, καὶ πᾶν ξύλον θύϊνον καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἐλεφάντινον καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἐκ ξύλου τιμιωτάτου καὶ χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου καὶ μαρμάρου,

controles.web: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
controles.kjv: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
controles.livre: Mercadoria de ouro, e de prata, e de pedras preciosas, e de pérolas, e de linho fino, e de púrpura, e de seda, e de escarlate; e de toda madeira aromática, e de todo objeto de marfim, e de todo objeto de madeira valiosíssima, e liga de cobre, e de ferro, e de mármore;

versos.grego: καὶ κιννάμωμον καὶ ἄμωμον καὶ θυμιάματα καὶ μύρον καὶ λίβανον καὶ οἶνον καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ σεμίδαλιν καὶ σῖτον καὶ κτήνη καὶ πρόβατα, καὶ ἵππων καὶ ῥεδῶν καὶ σωμάτων, καὶ ψυχὰς ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
controles.kjv: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
controles.livre: E canela, e perfumes, e óleo aromático, e incenso, e vinho, e azeite, e farinha fina, e trigo, e gado, e ovelhas; e de cavalos, e de carruagens, e de corpos e almas humanas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡ ὀπώρα σου τῆς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ψυχῆς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ λιπαρὰ καὶ τὰ λαμπρὰ ἀπώλετο ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ αὐτὰ εὑρήσουσιν.

controles.web: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.
controles.kjv: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
controles.livre: E o fruto do mau desejo de tua alma foi embora de ti; e todas as coisas deliciosas e excelentes foram embora de ti; e tu não mais as acharás.

versos.grego: οἱ ἔμποροι τούτων, οἱ πλουτήσαντες ἀπ’ αὐτῆς, ἀπὸ μακρόθεν στήσονται διὰ τὸν φόβον τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῆς κλαίοντες καὶ πενθοῦντες,

controles.web: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;
controles.kjv: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
controles.livre: Os comerciantes destas coisas, que por ela se enriqueceram, estarão de longe por medo do tormento dela, chorando e lamentando,

versos.grego: λέγοντες Οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, ἡ περιβεβλημένη βύσσινον καὶ πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον, καὶ κεχρυσωμένη ἐν χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίτῃ,

controles.web: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
controles.kjv: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
controles.livre: E dizendo: Ai, ai daquela grande cidade, que estava vestida de linho fino, e púrpura, e escarlate; e adornada com ouro, pedras preciosas, e pérolas! Porque em uma hora tantas riquezas foram assoladas.

versos.grego: ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἠρημώθη ὁ τοσοῦτος πλοῦτος. καὶ πᾶς κυβερνήτης καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἐπὶ τόπον πλέων καὶ ναῦται καὶ ὅσοι τὴν θάλασσαν ἐργάζονται, ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔστησαν

controles.web: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,
controles.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
controles.livre: E todo capitão de embarcação, e todos d a multidão que estavam em barcos, e marinheiros, e todos os que trabalham no mar, se puseram de longe;

versos.grego: καὶ ἔκραζον βλέποντες τὸν καπνὸν τῆς πυρώσεως αὐτῆς λέγοντες Τίς ὁμοία τῇ πόλει τῇ μεγάλῃ;

controles.web: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
controles.kjv: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
controles.livre: E vendo a fumaça da queima dela, clamaram, dizendo: Havia algo comparável a esta grande cidade?

versos.grego: καὶ ἔβαλον χοῦν ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔκραζον κλαίοντες καὶ πενθοῦντες, λέγοντες Οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, ἐν ᾗ ἐπλούτησαν πάντες οἱ ἔχοντες τὰ πλοῖα ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἐκ τῆς τιμιότητος αὐτῆς, ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἠρημώθη.

controles.web: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For in one hour is she made desolate.
controles.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
controles.livre: E eles lançaram pó em suas cabeças, e clamaram, chorando e lamentando, dizendo: Ai, ai daquela grande cidade, em que todos os que tinham barcos no mar se enriqueceram da opulência dela! Porque em uma hora ela foi assolada.

versos.grego: Εὐφραίνου ἐπ’ αὐτῇ, οὐρανέ καὶ οἱ ἅγιοι καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ προφῆται, ὅτι ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸ κρίμα ὑμῶν ἐξ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
controles.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
controles.livre: Alegra-te sobre ela, céu; e também vós santos apóstolos e profetas; porque Deus já tem julgado dela vossa causa.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἦρεν εἷς ἄγγελος ἰσχυρὸς λίθον ὡς μύλινον μέγαν, καὶ ἔβαλεν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν λέγων Οὕτως ὁρμήματι βληθήσεται Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη πόλις, καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ἔτι.

controles.web: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
controles.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
controles.livre: E um forte anjo levantou uma pedra, como uma grande pedra de moinho, e a lançou no mar, dizendo: Com tal violência Babilônia será lançada, aquela grande cidade, e não mais será achada.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνὴ κιθαρῳδῶν καὶ μουσικῶν καὶ αὐλητῶν καὶ σαλπιστῶν οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ πᾶς τεχνίτης πάσης τέχνης οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ φωνὴ μύλου οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι,

controles.web: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
controles.kjv: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
controles.livre: E voz de harpistas, e de músicos, e de flautistas, e de tocadores de trombeta, não mais se ouvirá em ti; e nenhum artesão de toda arte não mais se achará em ti; e ruído de moinho não mais se ouvirá em ti.

versos.grego: καὶ φῶς λύχνου οὐ μὴ φάνῃ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ φωνὴ νυμφίου καὶ νύμφης οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι· ὅτι οἱ ἔμποροί σου ἦσαν οἱ μεγιστᾶνες τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἐν τῇ φαρμακίᾳ σου ἐπλανήθησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη,

controles.web: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
controles.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
controles.livre: E luz de lâmpada não mais iluminará em ti; e voz de noivo e de noiva não mais se ouvirá em ti; porque teus comerciantes eram os grandes da terra, porque por tuas feitiçarias todas as nações foram enganadas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ αἷμα προφητῶν καὶ ἁγίων εὑρέθη καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐσφαγμένων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
controles.kjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
controles.livre: E nela se achou o sangue dos profetas e dos santos, e de todos os que foram mortos sobre a terra.
